events.name: Bash
events.head: Check launchd jobs, plists, cloudflared processes
events.input: $ launchctl list | grep -i revops; ls -la ~/Library/LaunchAgents | grep -i revops; pgrep -fl cloudflared | head; ls -d ~/tantra-onboarding-v2 2>/dev/null; git -C /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign remote -v | head -2; ls /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign/cloud/src/connectors/ | head -30

events.name: Bash
events.head: Inspect plists, tunnel config, onboarding repo
events.input: $ cat ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.revops-relay-tunnel.plist | grep -iE 'log|string' ; grep -iE 'log|<string>' ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.revops-relay.plist | grep -viE 'key|secret|token'; cat ~/.cloudflared/revops/config.yml | grep -vE 'credentials|secret' | head -20; cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-onboarding-v2 && git status --short | head; git log --oneline -1; git remote -v | head -1

events.name: Bash
events.head: Back up plists, bootout both relay jobs
events.input: $ set -e; B=~/tantra-backups/2026-10-09; mkdir -p $B; for j in com.tantra.revops-relay com.tantra.revops-relay-tunnel; do cp ~/Library/LaunchAgents/$j.plist $B/$j.plist.DISARMED; done; ls $B | grep relay; grep -o 'Logs/[^<]*\|/tmp/[^<]*' ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.revops-relay.plist || true

events.name: Bash
events.head: Delete plists and logs, verify, grep repos
events.input: $ rm ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.revops-relay.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.revops-relay-tunnel.plist; rm -f ~/Library/Logs/revops-relay.log ~/Library/Logs/revops-relay-tunnel.log; ls /tmp | grep -i relay; launchctl list | grep revops-relay || echo "launchctl: no revops-relay"; ls ~/Library/LaunchAgents | grep relay || echo "no relay plists"; lsof -nP -iTCP:8793 -sTCP:LISTEN || echo "nothing on 8793"

events.name: Bash
events.head: Check port 8793 and the probe default port
events.input: $ cd /Users/adithyamurali/tantra-redesign; netstat -anv -p tcp | grep -E '\.8793 ' | head -3 || true; sed -n 1,8p app/scripts/probe-admin-tokens.mjs; git log --oneline -2 -- app/scripts/probe-admin-tokens.mjs; grep -rn '878[0-9]\|879[0-9]' cloud/wrangler*.toml cloud/package.json 2>/dev/null | head; grep -o 'localhost:[0-9]*\|--port[ =][0-9]*' ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.tantra.revops-centre-dev.plist
